about: Gravity ends Telekinesis (653137d8f) and forbids Telekinesis and Flying Press (e2c494b55). A level-10 Pikachu is given Growl, Telekinesis, Gravity and Flying Press in the running battle (teach:) against a forced wild level-5 Chansey that knows only Growl. Telekinesis lifts the Chansey; Gravity, the next turn, brings it down at once, and the three turns Telekinesis gave it end with no line; then the selection screen turns down Flying Press and Telekinesis because of gravity, and gym.py's player takes Growl instead. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.

lines: The wild Chansey was hurled into the air!
The wild Chansey fell from the sky due to the gravity!
Pikachu can’t use Flying Press because of gravity!
Pikachu can’t use Telekinesis because of gravity!
